tA.text: A · Tokens and core components (provisional brand)

nA1.text:
API / code mapping (pass 2)
• Tokens ship as CSS variables in packages/ui. Components use SEMANTIC tokens only; --qci-* appear only in :root.
• Pass 2 adds exactly three: --color-brand-primary-active, --color-brand-on-tint, --color-brand-tint-border (A-01).
• Status groups beyond bookings (payment, dispute, report version, accreditation, payout, refund, claim, verification, file scan) are 'Proposed, for review'. ON_HOLD card = warning; suspended accreditation = warning.
• Money ₹1,00,000.00 (Proposed) · every time ends with IST.

nA2.text:
API / code mapping
• Money = {amountPaise:int64, currency:'INR'} (common.yaml) → formatted en-IN: ₹1,00,000.00. Never float.
• DateTime: API timestamps are UTC ISO-8601 → displayed IST with the 'IST' suffix; dates DD MMM YYYY.
• BookingNo: bookingNo (LC-YYMM-NNNNNNN, OQ-22).
• FileUpload state ← BookingAttachment.scanStatus.
• Masked: phone/bank masked by the server (e.g. bankAccountNumberLast4); the client never unmasks.

nA3.text:
API / code mapping
• NextActionCard ← status + the matching deadline: labDecisionDueAt · paymentDueAt · dropDeadlineAt · holdCase.dueAt · counterOffer.expiresAt · disputeWindowEndsAt.
• BookingTimeline ← GET /bookings/{id}/timeline: kind (STATUS_CHANGE | CUSTODY_EVENT), occurredAt, actorRole, actorName (own org only, OQ-29), fromStatus, toStatus, custodyEventType, packageSeqNo.
• LabResultCard ← LabSearchResult.
• ApprovalPanel 'blocked' ← LabInboxItem.viewerWasMaker (the API refuses as well).
• CameraScanner ← POST /custody/scan → CustodyScanResult.result.

nA4.text:
API / code mapping
• VerificationResult ← ReportVerification.result: GENUINE_CURRENT | GENUINE_SUPERSEDED | NOT_FOUND | REVOKED.
• DataTable pagination ← page (cursor) on every *List schema.
• ErrorState copy comes from ERROR_HANDLING.md code → message map (e.g. 409 INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION → 'This booking has moved on. Refresh to see its current state.').
• DiffViewer ← change-set items / price-list versions. ImportPreview ← import rows (create / update / no change / conflict / error).
